capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Make strategic investments in Kalyani Group Companies with a long-term hold intent, evaluating opportunities considering macroeconomic conditions.
- The Board has recommended a final dividend of Rs. 10/- per equity share for the year ended March 31, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. The Company has adopted a Dividend Distribution Policy in terms of Regulation 43A of SEBI Listing Regulations. No fresh investments were made during the year; closing balances of investments are disclosed in the financial statements.
- The Company ensures safety of all its employees working at different places.
- Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) is prepared and disclosed as per SEBI Listing Regulations, covering environmental, social and governance initiatives.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Company is a Non-Deposit taking Core Investment Company whose main object is to make strategic investments in Kalyani Group Companies. Investments are held for the long term and are not held for sale. The Company evaluates opportunities and invests considering macroeconomic conditions. No specific capex or capacity expansion projects are disclosed, as the Company's operations are limited to holding investments and earning dividend income.

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Concentration risk to Kalyani Group dividends — Main source of income is dividends from Kalyani Group Companies; any operational or financial distress in those investee companies could materially reduce dividend inflows.
- Securities market fluctuation and devaluation of investments — Fluctuations in the securities market and global economic scenario may pose a risk of devaluation of the Company's investment portfolio.
- Credit risk on loans and interest — Non-recovery of principal amounts lent and interest thereon could impair asset quality and income.
- Regulatory risk as a Core Investment Company — The Company operates as a Non-Deposit taking Core Investment Company under RBI Directions; any change in regulatory classification or non-compliance could affect its operating framework.
- Macro-economic sensitivity of investment decisions — The Company evaluates opportunities based on macro-economic conditions; adverse macro shifts could constrain investment returns and strategic deployment.
